calls.statement:
WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.member_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY receipt_id, line_no, sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) m, s.store_id=900 is_web, COUNT(*) n, SUM(net_amount) net, MIN(etl_loaded_at), MAX(etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
agg AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.net_sales ty, ly.net_sales ly, ROUND(100.0*(ty.net_sales/ly.net_sales-1),2) g
FROM agg ty JOIN agg ly ON ly.region=ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS v
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND n.store_id<900
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS c
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) st, m.v, c.c, ROUND(m.v-c.c,2) diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.fiscal_year=m.fiscal_year AND c.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE m.v IS NULL OR c.c IS NULL OR ABS(m.v-c.c)>0.5 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'ZZ/999 effect' k, d.fiscal_year, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount),2) v
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test') GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ZZ in web (returns+lines, any date)', 'x', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test'
UNION ALL
